topics.label: Introduction to cancer biology and lecture learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes students and frames the lecture through its aims and learning outcomes.

topics.label: Accumulation of genetic and epigenetic changes in cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how genetic, epigenetic, and infection-related changes accumulate during cancer development.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes cancer as a breakdown of normal differentiation and the organized relationships within tissues.

topics.label: Cell culture models of cancer and their limitations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic considers what cancer-cell culture can reveal and what is missed when tumor cells are studied outside their tissue context.

topics.label: Tumor behavior: invasion, metastasis, and benign growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how invasion and metastatic spread indicate malignant behavior, contrast that behavior with benign growth, and describe the potential progression and consequences of benign tumors.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature by tissue of origin and malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic sets out how tumor names generally reflect their tissue of origin and whether they are benign or malignant.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer-related illness and death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how tumors disrupt normal bodily functions and how primary and secondary tumors can cause death.

topics.label: Tumor incidence across human and animal populations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare how often different tumors occur and how incidence patterns vary across human and animal populations.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain why cancers can be difficult to detect and examine screening approaches for finding them earlier.

topics.label: Lecture close: learning outcomes, revision and practicals
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by returning to the learning outcomes and pointing students toward revision and practicals.
